content.comment_body: Hello, 1. How can I store data from the VM of [product_name] [version_no] in a log file on the local host in real time, similar to what is shown on the [product_name] variable screen? Which software should I use and learn to accomplish this? 2. Is it possible to modify the appearance of the [product_name] variable screen and add custom text labels to it? Thank you!
Regarding your second question: No, it is not possible to change or customize the [product_name] variable screen.
Regarding your first question: You might be able to achieve this with third-party software available for personal use, possibly free of charge. See [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for a solution to log VM data from [product_name] [version_no] to a local file in real time and also to customize the appearance of the [product_name] variable screen. Replies indicate that direct customization of the variable screen is not allowed, and suggest using third-party software for logging data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to log VM data from [product_name] [version_no] to a local file in real time and to personalize the interface of the variable screen by adding text labels.
